latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Opus AI Video Editor Skill.

- Instantly edit and export videos via AI: upload raw footage, specify edits, and receive a finished 1080p MP4.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, and more formats up to 500MB per file.
- Automatic session management and token handling — free anonymous usage available.
- Natural language prompts trigger intelligent edits: highlight selection, captions, aspect ratio changes, and more.
- Full cloud-based workflow: no local installation required; edits and export run on cloud GPUs.
- Clear user feedback on status, errors, and progress throughout the editing and export process.
